test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As a result of which act did Queen Victoria, who was the monarch of Britain, also became the sovereign of British territories in India, with the title "Empress of India" in 1858?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Government Of India Act__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Government of India Act of 1919 **was passed to expand the legislative councils and provide for the election of some members.
 
• This act did not result in Queen Victoria becoming the Empress of India.
 
• The act did, however, provide for some limited Indian participation in the government of India.
 
• **The Indian Councils Act of 1861** was passed to allow for the addition of Indian members to the legislative councils in India.
 
• This act did not result in Queen Victoria becoming the Empress of India.
 
• The act did, however, provide for greater Indian representation in the government of India.
 
• **The Charter Act of 1833 **was passed to abolish the East India Company's monopoly on trade with India.
 
• This act did not result in Queen Victoria becoming the Empress of India.
 
• The act did, however, provide for some limited Indian representation in the government of India.
 
• **The Regulating Act of 1773 **was passed to establish British control over the East India Company.
 
• This act did not result in Queen Victoria becoming the Empress of India.
 
• The act did, however, provide for greater British oversight of the East India Company's activities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Government of India Act of 1858 granted Queen Victoria the title of Empress of India and made her the sovereign of British territories in India.
 
• This act was passed following the Indian Rebellion of 1857, which led to the dissolution of the East India Company and the transfer of power to the British Crown.
